intro: Identification of privacy legislation mentions in GitHub issues and Discussions across Hugging Face repositories.
pending: A dash indicates a pending result. Pilot data is a limited preview, explicitly marked as preliminary, and is not a scientific result.
method: Discovery precedes repository selection. Confirmation records textual occurrences and their provenance; categories follow the study codebook.
cutoff: Inclusive content cutoff: September 22, 2026, UTC. Missing or invalid issue and discussion dates do not establish eligibility. Repositories may have been created before or after the cutoff.
github: GitHub: global search for legal terms in public closed issues; excludes pull requests and issues whose authors are identified as bots. A repository needs both an AI/ML discovery signal and technical evidence. Collection reads root manifests and the README when needed; source files and subdirectories are not traversed.
hf: Hugging Face: discovery of models, datasets, Spaces and Kernels under each OSI license; Buckets are excluded because they are not units with Discussions. A Spaces listing may omit gated status, so the collector checks Space details. Since the field is optional, an absent or null value means not gated; auto, manual, or invalid values are excluded. Kernels have their own metadata. The Kernel listing route used by the collector is not among the generally documented official methods; its pagination and coverage need live validation before this part can be treated as complete. Metadata and README are used to confirm license and AI/ML purpose. Only closed Discussions are accepted; pull requests and bot-started discussions are excluded. Bot comments on eligible discussions are preserved.
licenses: Both platforms: recognized SPDX license from the local OSI list. The time cutoff applies to issue and discussion creation, not repository creation. Every identifier in a license expression must be approved. Forks and archived repositories are accepted; there are no popularity thresholds.
concepts: 20 concepts: original and revised keyword lists from the replication package, matched with word boundaries and separate provenance. 24 codebook-defined categories, without automatic keyword classification.
sampling: Strata: platform × repository type × law. Cochran with finite population correction: 99% confidence, 5% margin, 50% proportion; sample size rounded up and capped by population. Sampling without replacement uses base seed 20260920 plus stratum index.
exports: CSV files for population, sample, strata, coding sheets and codebook, plus a hashed manifest, are stored in inputs/final/collection for subsequent analyses. Raw data and tokens are not copied to the website.
full: The --run option collects both platforms and analyzes a temporary database. The official database is replaced only after success, with archival of the previous one. Analysis verifies the latest attempts, unresolved problems, cutoff, versions and raw response hashes.
publication: The site is prepared for GitHub Pages. Publication uses a manual workflow. Local tests and rendering do not create commits or publish the project.
limits: Textual mentions do not establish legal compliance or violations. GitHub repository totals refer to repositories found through searches for legislation mentions, without estimating all AI/ML repositories. Hugging Face discovery depends on license indexing. Pilots demonstrate a limited workflow; full coverage, duration and quota consumption require validation.
unfinished: AI/ML selection accuracy and license coverage still require empirical validation.
rq_scope: GitHub versus Hugging Face is part of all three RQs. General OSS comparisons belong to RQ1 and RQ2. There is no RQ4 or before/after GDPR experiment. Automated comments on human-initiated discussions remain available as context.
no_collection: Scientific collection has not run yet.
preliminary_pilot: Preliminary preview based only on limited pilot data; these are not scientific results.
pilot: Preliminary, limited pilot data. Runs {github_run} (GitHub) and {hf_run} (Hugging Face), from {started} to {finished} UTC. Protocol {protocol_version}; cutoff {cutoff} UTC. Unique repositories: GitHub, {github_catalogued} catalogued, {github_eligible} eligible and {github_evidence_repositories} with legal mentions; Hugging Face, {hf_catalogued} catalogued, {hf_eligible} eligible and {hf_evidence_repositories} with legal mentions. Spaces: {spaces_scope}; Kernels: {kernels_scope}. Limits: up to {model_limit} discovered and {hf_eligible_limit} eligible repositories per HF type, {discussion_limit} Discussions per repository and up to {github_results_limit} search results per GitHub term. These counts do not represent the population.
official: Official full collection validated at {saved} UTC. Runs {github_run} (GitHub) and {hf_run} (Hugging Face). Verified coverage of unique repositories: GitHub, {github_catalogued} catalogued, {github_eligible} eligible and {github_evidence_repositories} with legal mentions; Hugging Face, {hf_catalogued} catalogued, {hf_eligible} eligible and {hf_evidence_repositories} with legal mentions.
collection_incomplete: The latest collections do not satisfy the protocol. Scientific results are pending.
analysis_pending: Collection complete. Sample analysis has not been prepared yet.
